Render a statci_report to standalone HTML, GitHub-Flavored Markdown, or JSON

Source: R/report.R
render_statci_report.Rd

Render a statci_report to standalone HTML, GitHub-Flavored Markdown, or JSON

Usage

render_statci_report(
  report,
  output_file = NULL,
  format = c("html", "markdown", "json"),
  title = NULL,
  open = FALSE
)

Arguments

report

A "statci_report" object created by statci_report().

output_file

Optional output file path. When NULL, returns the rendered document as a character scalar without writing to disk.

format

Output format: "html" (standalone HTML5 dashboard), "markdown" (GitHub-Flavored Markdown suitable for $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY), or "json" (machine-readable JSON; requires jsonlite).

title

Optional override for the report title.

open

Logical; if TRUE, interactive(), and output_file is provided, opens the rendered report in the default browser.

Value

If output_file is NULL, returns the rendered character scalar; otherwise writes the file and returns output_file invisibly.

Examples

rep <- statci_report(lint = stat_lint_text("x <- rnorm(10)\n"))
md <- render_statci_report(rep, format = "markdown")
cat(md)
#> # statci Statistical CI/CD Audit Report
#> 
#> **Overall Status:** **FAIL** | **Generated:** 2026-11-24 21:43:32 UTC | **statci:** v0.5.1
#> 
#> ## Executive Summary
#> 
#> | Section | Status | Checks | Passed | Warnings | Failures | Summary |
#> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
#> | AST Statistical Linter | **FAIL** | 20 | 19 | 0 | 1 | 1 file(s), 1 finding(s) (1 error, 0 warning, 0 info) |
#> 
#> ## 1. AST Statistical Linter
#> 
#> | File | Line | Chunk | Severity | Rule | Message |
#> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
#> | &lt;text:r&gt; | 1 | — | ERROR | `unseeded_randomness` | Stochastic call `rnorm()` invoked without a preceding `set.seed()` or `withr::with_seed()` call. |
